parameters.acceptance: Fresh canonical position, no check/terminal/claimable draw; finite scores at both budgets, abs(verified)<=1500, first PV move identical and white cp difference<=50, bucket quota available. No selection by Aster evaluator errors/moves. Preserve every queried candidate, native mate labels, rejection reasons, histories and source outcome; source results are descriptive, unresolved kept separate.
parameters.history: Labels from fresh FEN with clock, no played repetition history. Full source histories/PGNs retained separately. Teacher player uses its own512-node process and game token; labeler clears between FEN queries.

source_policy: Independent512-node teacher player,3% seeded random legal moves from8 fixed opening lines. Labels use separate cold FEN-only search. Source outcomes are descriptive, never oracle values.
